references.text: Describes the avenger of blood and his role in pursuing murderers, as well as the need for cities of refuge.
The avenger of blood has the right to kill the murderer if he finds him outside the city of refuge.
Distinguishes between intentional murder and unintentional killing, where the latter does not deserve the death penalty.
Describes the purpose of cities of refuge for one who kills their neighbor unintentionally without prior enmity.
Gives an example of unintentional killing where the killer had no hatred toward the victim beforehand.
Contrast: describes when a man hates his neighbor and kills him intentionally - then the elders shall hand him over.
Joshua establishes cities of refuge to protect those who kill unintentionally from the avenger of blood.
Basic law regarding refuge for unintentional killing versus intentional murder.
